en: The Section on the Past and Future (Atītānāgatavāra)
He who has fully understood the eye-base will also fully understand the ear-base? No.
Or rather, he who will fully understand the ear-base has also fully understood the eye-base? No.
He who has not fully understood the eye-base will also not fully understand the ear-base?
Those who will attain the path have not fully understood the eye-base, but they will not fail to fully understand the ear-base.
Those who possess the highest path and those worldlings who will not attain the path have neither fully understood the eye-base nor will they fully understand the ear-base.
Or again, whoever will not fully understand the ear-base, did that person not fully understand the eye-base?
An Arahant will not fully understand the ear-base, but he did not fail to fully understand the eye-base.

Those who possess the highest path (agga-maggasamaṅgī) and those worldlings (puthujjana) who will not attain the path will neither fully understand the ear-base nor did they fully understand the eye-base.
The Paṭṭhāna Manual on the Pairs of Bases is finished.
